prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, natural skin texture with pores, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: Cassie, a fictional 23-year-old, Lauren's daughter and Natalie's spoiled stepsister, who schemes to send Natalie into the marriage meant for her; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: Young woman of 23 with a small V-shaped face, a pointed chin, a small upturned nose and wide blue eyes. She wears heavy lashes, glossy pink lips and contoured cheeks. Long wavy platinum-blonde hair falls to mid-back, styled in loose curls. She is slim and petite, about 162 cm. She wears a thin gold chain necklace, gold hoop earrings and long pink manicured nails.. Wearing one outfit only: A pale-pink silk slip dress with thin straps, falling to mid-thigh, under a cropped white tweed-texture long-sleeve jacket worn open. Pink strappy heeled sandals. All plain, with no logos.. Signature colour: pink. Expression in the close-up shows: Spoiled, mocking and calculating. She enjoys humiliating Natalie, wants to escape her arranged marriage to Sebastian Klein, and smirks when her plan works..
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 23, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
